toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Net binne die deur' is the natural Afrikaans way to say just inside the door; 'binne by die deur' reads awkwardly.
toegepas.fout: 'Binne by die deur' is a stiff, unidiomatic way to place the smell just inside the entrance.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Net binne die deur' is the natural Afrikaans phrase and keeps the same place and the same smell.

toegepas.voor: Die stoele was laag genoeg dat
toegepas.na: Die stoele was so laag dat
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Laag genoeg dat' copies English 'low enough that'; Afrikaans uses 'so laag dat'.
toegepas.fout: 'Laag genoeg dat' copies the English 'low enough that'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'So laag dat' is the native construction and says exactly the same thing about the chairs and the child's feet.

toegepas.voor: Sy het stadig gepraat en ons het almal
toegepas.na: Sy het stadig gepraat, en ons het almal
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma goes before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Sy het ... gepraat' / 'ons het ... geluister').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation fix required by the AWS 2017; no wording or meaning changes.

toegepas.voor: Ek luister tot die einde en ek jaag
toegepas.na: Ek luister tot die einde, en ek jaag
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma goes before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Ek luister' / 'ek jaag').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation fix required by the AWS 2017; the sergeant's words stay exactly as they are.

laat_vaar.voor: Daarna het sy ook oor 'n ander plek vertel.
laat_vaar.na: Daarna het sy ook van 'n ander plek vertel.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Van iets vertel' is the standard idiom; 'oor iets vertel' is a looser, English-influenced form, and the protected word 'vertel' is kept.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Vertel oor' is accepted, natural Afrikaans with the same meaning as 'vertel van', so the preposition swap is a lateral move in the story.

laat_vaar.voor: Daar is beddens en kos en
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A three-item list reads more smoothly with a comma than with a repeated 'en'; the protected wording that follows is untouched.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The repeated 'en' in 'beddens en kos en grootmense' is natural spoken rhythm in the sergeant's dialogue and does not jar, so the change only alters her voice.
